newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain must be in EMU launch - Bank of Spain's Rojo.
newsitem.headline: Spain must be in EMU launch - Bank of Spain's Rojo.

text.p: Bank of Spain governor Luis Angel Rojo said on Wednesday that Spain must be in the first phase of monetary union and that it cannot count on delays in the original timetable.
Answering questions from parliament members, Rojo said it would be "a clear mistake for Spain not to be included in EMU."
"Trying to join is fundamental. We cannot count on their being delays. We would risk arriving late and becoming desperate. We must be included in the first phase.
"There are certain grades of flexibility (for the criteria) but we mustn't count on the laxity being great," Rojo said.
